Panel artifact: last 24 month-ends = 281,986 rows (asof, code, period_end, avail_event, avail_tier, roe, net profit, revenue) in the gitignored data lane, regenerate with one command; the emitted panel is asserted lookahead-free at the write site (no row with avail_event > asof).
